source: const W=eval(load("jobboardWSource"));async function choose(tab,id,value,filter=false){await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_open({tabId:tab,open:true});await W.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").closest('.select__control').scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'instant'});true");let r=await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_click({tabId:tab,selector:'.select__control:has([id="'+id+'"]) button'});if(r.isError){await W.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").focus();true");await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_press({tabId:tab,key:"ArrowDown"})}if(filter){await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_type({tabId:tab,selector:'[id="'+id+'"]',text:value,clear:true});await W.delay(600)}await W.delay(300);if(await W.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").getAttribute('aria-expanded')")!=='true'){await W.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").focus();true");await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_press({tabId:tab,key:'ArrowDown'});await W.delay(200)}const opts=await W.ev(tab,"[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].filter(x=>x.id.startsWith('react-select')).map(x=>({id:x.id,text:x.innerText}))");const o=opts.find(x=>x.text.toLowerCase()===value.toLowerCase());if(!o)return {id,opts};return W.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(o.id)+").click();true")};({choose});
